examBasis.title: Ontario Water Wastewater Certification Office - Preparing for Your Exam
examBasis.note: OWWCO states that the OIT exam uses current Ontario content and consists of 40 general questions plus selectable Water Treatment, Water Distribution/Supply, Wastewater Treatment and Wastewater Collection modules. This package is an expanded practice pool, not a copy of an official examination form.
